thread:
Elaine: Quick check — PM wants us to lock down what actually needs to land for the MVP. We're getting pressure from sales to keep SSO, but infra says other items are blockers. Can we agree on a small cutlist?
Mike: My priority is: 1) core inference API, 2) auth, 3) basic observability. Everything else is negotiable.
Sarah: Agreed on core + auth. We should define 'auth' precisely — does that include org provisioning and SCIM?
Elaine: Good point. Sales asked for org-level onboarding, but that could be a v1 ask. We can offer a limited SSO preview instead.
Ana: Technically, org provisioning (SCIM + provisioning UI) is a 2-week lift with current infra. If we remove it from MVP we save the rollout/backup work. But note: our rollout scripts assume org metadata in the DB; we'll need a fallback path.
Tom: Alternative: push MVP by 2 weeks, include org provisioning and RBAC, keep observability basic. Which is less risky for customers?
Mike: Pushing the date risks cadences and marketing alignment. I'd rather keep date and reduce scope.
Sarah: Proposed cutlist for MVP: - drop org provisioning (move to v1) - drop fine-grained RBAC (v1) - keep basic SSO (OAuth/OIDC) for early customers - move advanced telemetry (sampling, custom dashboards) to v1
Ana: Implementation notes: keeping basic SSO means supporting OIDC login + token exchange. We can reuse the existing auth-service and skip SCIM. Quick patch needed: disable org-create in the sign-up flow.
Elaine: Launch criteria draft for MVP (customer-facing): - Core API endpoints working, passing integration tests - Auth: OIDC login + token issuance - Latency under 300ms P95 for 4k token seqs - Billing + quota enforcement enabled - Minimal usage analytics (request counts, errors)
Tom: Who owns the org-create fallback change? @Ana?
Ana: I'll pick it up, estimate 1.5 days to add toggle + 1 day for regression tests.
Mike: I'll update the milestone board: set MVP feature flag to the new cutlist and mark org provisioning as v1.
Elaine: Ok. Decision: Keep date, adopt cutlist above. We will communicate to sales: 'SSO preview available, full org provisioning in v1'.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature-flag-update -> staging at 2024-01-10T09:30:00Z
Sarah: Follow-up: can we add a short note in the release doc explaining rationale (customer risk vs time-to-market)? I'll draft it.
Elaine: Thanks — please @channel when release note is up.
Mike: Updated milestone: MVP ship target unchanged. Cutting list committed.
Ana: Starting work on fallback toggle now.
Elaine: End of thread — we'll reconvene if any blockers pop up.
